note: Machine-readable inventory of the mobile SDK packages, apps, and their permission/capability posture. Seed for `make mobile-security-check`. Hand-maintained per landing; not generated.

apps.name: @aether/kyber-mobile
apps.governed_actions_status: deferred_c5_c7 (reuse Kyber command plane; no new mutation channel)

isolation_invariants: distinct bundle ids per app (enforced by scripts/mobile_build_check.py)
distinct product planes per app (aether tenant vs kyber workforce)
no Aether tenant code in the Kyber binary and vice-versa
an Aether token cannot call Kyber (separate audiences)
push token / deep link / continuation id are not authorization
raw push tokens and access tokens are never logged; only token_hash is stored server-side
externally_blocked: native iOS-simulator / Android-emulator compile (no macOS/Xcode/Android SDK/Expo in the Linux CI container)
store distribution (TestFlight / Play internal track) — C8, staged
